Coryell was identified and excluded as non-SCOTUS, but the staged CSV also omits multiple other non-SCOTUS article rows, and there is no cited Court column or systematic filtering source in source_urls. The CSV uses a separate outgoing-chief tie-break rule, but that rule is not encoded in db_analog and the cited source_urls do not include the per-case pages that allegedly verify the actual dates.
